mapper.select:
SELECT t.id id, t.NAME_ABBREVIATION abbrName FROM sg_tccon_tcgrid_b t where t.NAME_ABBREVIATION is not null
and t.NAME_ABBREVIATION like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.NAME_ABBREVIATION LIMIT 0,10

SELECT t.code id, t.name abbrName FROM sg_dic_tcdispatchlevel t where t.name is not null
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.code LIMIT 0,10

SELECT t.tms_id id, t.tms_name abbrName FROM sg_org_company_b t where t.tms_name is not null
and t.tms_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.tms_name LIMIT 0,10
select t.id as modelId, t.model_version modelVersion, t.table_name tableName, t.table_name_cn tableNameCn from t_meta_model t where t.table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT t.code id, t.name abbrName FROM SG_DIC_VOLTAGETYPE t where t.name is not null
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.code
select t.id from t_meta_model_tech t where t.column_name = #{columnName} and t.model_id = #{modelId}

SELECT t.code id, t.name abbrName FROM sg_dic_tcstate t where t.name is not null
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.code

SELECT t.code id, t.name abbrName FROM sg_dic_tcstationlevel t where t.name is not null
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.code

SELECT t.code id, t.name abbrName FROM sg_dic_tcstationtype t where t.name is not null
and t.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY t.code

SELECT tech.column_name_cn label, tech.column_name name, tech.model_id modelId, tech.model_version modelVersion, tech.id id, IFNULL(sw.is_advanced_query_index,'0') ifQuery, 0 ifOpen, 0 ifMoreChoose, sw.advanced_query_order sort FROM t_meta_model_tech tech LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_show sw ON ( tech.id = sw.column_id AND tech.model_version = sw.model_version ) WHERE tech.model_id = #{modelId} AND tech.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND sw.is_advanced_query = '1' ORDER BY sw.advanced_query_order

SELECT rule.select_type type, model.table_name tableName, tech.column_name id, tech1.column_name NAME, rule.customized_sql cuzSql FROM t_quality_verification_rules rule LEFT JOIN t_quality_basic_rules brule ON CONCAT( brule.id ) = rule.rule_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model model ON CONCAT( model.id ) = rule.rel_meta_mode_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_tech tech ON CONCAT( tech.id )= rule.rel_id_meta_model_column_id LEFT JOIN t_meta_model_tech tech1 ON CONCAT( tech1.id ) = rule.rel_name_meta_model_column_id WHERE rule.meta_mode_id = #{modelId} AND rule.meta_model_column_id = #{columnId} AND rule.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND rule.state = '0' AND brule.english_name = 'DicRangeVerification'
select ${id} code,${name} name from ${table} where ${id} is not null order by ${name} asc
